subject: Aligning next steps — 30m product intro & MAP (Cobalt Health)
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning next steps — 30m product intro & MAP (Cobalt Health)

Hi Emma —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for walking through Cobalt Health's current inference bottlenecks and the production constraints (HIPAA scope, VPC needs, and 99th %-ile latency targets). Quick recap + proposed next step below.

Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + anonymized embeddings for search (sensitive PII flows through controlled pipelines).
- Success metric: 25% reduction in inference cost per request and predictable 95th/99th latency under 500ms for the median workload.
- Technical must-haves: private deployment option (VPC), KMS integration, and audit logs for retention policy.

Proposed next step:
- 30-minute product intro + short architecture Q&A with our infra engineer (ideal audience: Emma, Max, and your lead data engineer).

To make this easy, here are three tight windows (I included PT/ET for clarity):
1) Tue Sep 8 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT / 1:00–1:30 PM ET
2) Wed Sep 9 — 2:30–3:00 PM PT / 5:30–6:00 PM ET
3) Thu Sep 10 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT / 12:00–12:30 PM ET

If none of those work, tell me a preferred day/time range and your timezone and I’ll propose alternates.

I’m attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and a tentative pilot timeline; also attaching a short one-sheet on the product. If you want me to iterate the MAP with your procurement/security contacts ahead of the demo, happy to do so.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_CobaltDraft.pdf (PDF), product-one-sheet.pdf (PDF)

Next steps from you: pick a preferred slot, and confirm the two technical stakeholders you want on the 30-minute intro (name + role).

Thanks — looking forward to getting a demo on the calendar.

—
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

High level — Tue Sep 8 or Thu Sep 10 both look promising for us. I need to confirm with Sarah (our data engineer) but tentatively Thu Sep 10 at 9:00 AM PT would be best.

Two quick clarifications before we lock:
- Can the demo show an example with a small, de-identified dataset? We want to validate KV cache behavior on real-ish sequences.
- Who from your side would cover KMS/key management and audit log details?

I’ll confirm Sarah’s availability (she’s on PTO Mon–Wed next week) and loop back by EOD tomorrow.

Emma / Max —

Thanks for the quick reply and the good questions. Short answers below, and I’ve expanded the MAP with owners/tasks (see attached).

- De-identified example data: yes — our infra engineer can walk through a live run with a small, synthetic dataset that mirrors the token lengths you described. We’ll avoid any PHI.
- KMS / key management: Priyom (cc’d) will own the KMS/KMS integration discussion in the call and can share our typical key lifecycle docs.

Proposed MAP highlights (attached):
- Week 1: Intro demo + technical Q&A (owner: Redwood AE + Infra)
- Week 2: Security questionnaire + evidence (owner: Cobalt + Redwood security)
- Week 3–4: Pilot setup (VPC peering, test dataset)
- Week 6: Pilot evaluation and next steps

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_CobaltDraft.pdf (PDF), product-one-sheet.pdf (PDF)

To confirm a calendar slot — I’ll tentatively hold Thu Sep 10, 9:00–9:30 AM PT for 24 hours. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and include Priyom for the KMS section and our infra engineer for the live demo.

Thanks —
David
